capabilities: Increase and decrease editor font size via status bar buttons
Reset font size via command palette commands
Configure step size, minimum, and maximum bounds
Scale headers proportionally while scaling body text independently
extras: Installation requires building from source with npm; no manual review by Obsidian staff per the manifest.
problem: Obsidian has no quick control for changing editor font size, especially per-view and persistently across restarts.
summary: Font size resizer that adjusts the editor font size from the status bar, command palette, or settings, with proportional header scaling.
